643-1168-3510-6705.easyPrerequisites: You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
643-1168-3510-6705.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Maskwood Nexus and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Toggo to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Toggo trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Quina.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

1456-5078-7175-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4399-4518-5998-6458.easyPrerequisites: Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
4399-4518-5998-6458.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Thunder of Unity trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thunder of Unity trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4518-5998-6458.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

2921-2946-4871-6112.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2921-2946-4871-6112.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1263-4871-4976-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

129-1409-4289-5434.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

5220-5256-7332.description:
Cast Casey & Raph by paying {4}{R}.
When Casey & Raph enters, it triggers. Choose its first mode targeting yourself.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Casey & Raph.
When Casey & Raph dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Casey & Raph onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Resolve the Casey & Raph trigger from step 2, causing you to exile Casey & Raph from the top of your ability with the ability to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Cast Casey & Raph from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

3967-6351-7084.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1090-2511-3817.description:
Cast Restoration Angel by paying its mana cost.
When Restoration Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Restoration Angel.
Resolve the Restoration Angel ability, blinking Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Restoration Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3062-3899-4552-5089.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Karn, the Great Creator
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

4013-5361-7009.manaNeeded: {2}{C} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
4013-5361-7009.description:
Activate Auton Soldier using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Auton Soldier. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

3305-3967-4681.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing Body Launderer to connive.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2933-4499-5798-6633.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-3228-5223-5477.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating three 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate the Soldiers by tapping them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.

411-2440-4758.description:
Cast Grinning Ignus by paying {2}{R}.
When Grinning Ignus enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Elemental you control.
Activate Crossroads Candleguide by paying {2}, adding {R}.
Activate Grinning Ignus by paying {R} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Repeat.

4050-5756-5917.description:
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Havi.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing The Jolly Balloon Man, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Jolly Balloon Man ability, creating a token copy of Havi that is a 1/1 Balloon.
Put the Havi token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Havi token dies, it triggers, returning The Jolly Balloon Man from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1846-2085-3525.easyPrerequisites:
You control an Island.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Kelpie Guide.
Kelpie Guide does not have summoning sickness.
1846-2085-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Kelpie Guide.
Kelpie Guide does not have summoning sickness.
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
1846-2085-3525.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
High Tide triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, untapping the Island.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Repeat from step 2
Activate any mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Kelpie Guide's first ability by tapping it, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Repeat.

791-3231-3693-6257.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
791-3231-3693-6257.description:
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1140-1636-3143-6175.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1140-1636-3143-6175.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Territorial Scythecat trigger.
Resolve the Territorial Scythecat trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

564-628-4659.notablePrerequisites: Monoskelion does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
564-628-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Monoskelion, adding {C}{C}.
When Monoskelion dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Monoskelion twice by paying {2} and removing two +1/+1 counters from it, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent

2749-4567.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 22 minus Greven's power.
2749-4567.description:
Activate Wall of Blood by paying 1 life.
Repeat step 1 until Greven has power 21 or greater due to its first ability.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Greven. The opponent loses the game due to being dealt 21 or more combat damage from your commander.

1348-3664-4657.notablePrerequisites: Magus of the Candelabra does not have summoning sickness.
1348-3664-4657.description:
Declare Magus of the Candelabra as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Maze of Ith by tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra and preventing all damage done to, and dealt by, it this turn.
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Maze of Ith and Lotus Field.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

914-5222-5256.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-5222-5256.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{W}.
Activate Sword of the Realms' equip ability by paying {1}{W}, attaching it to Dockside Extortionist.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist.
When Dockside Extortionist dies, Sword of the Realms triggers, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Dockside Extortionist's power.
Repeat.
